enableValidPageBadge.title: Show Valid Page Badge
enableValidPageBadge.description: Display validation badge on legitimate Microsoft login pages

validPageBadgeTimeout.title: Valid Page Badge Timeout (seconds)
validPageBadgeTimeout.description: Auto-dismiss timeout for the valid page badge in seconds. Set to 0 for no timeout (badge stays visible until manually dismissed).

cippServerUrl.title: CIPP Server URL
cippServerUrl.description: Base URL for CIPP reporting server

cippTenantId.title: CIPP Tenant ID/Domain
cippTenantId.description: Tenant identifier to include with CIPP alerts for multi-tenant environments

customRulesUrl.title: Custom Rules URL
customRulesUrl.description: URL to fetch custom detection rules from

updateInterval.title: Update Interval (hours)
updateInterval.description: How often to update detection rules in hours

urlAllowlist.title: URL Allowlist (URLs with wildcards or Regex)
urlAllowlist.description: Array of URL patterns or regex patterns to allowlist URLs from detection. Supports simple URLs with * wildcards (e.g., https://google.com/*) or advanced regex patterns.

items.title: URL Pattern or Regex
items.description: URL with wildcards (e.g., https://google.com/*) or regular expression pattern to match URLs that should be allowlisted

externalAllowlistFeeds.title: External Allowlist Feed URLs
externalAllowlistFeeds.description: Array of URLs that return lists of URL patterns to allowlist from detection. Each feed may be a JSON array of strings or plain text (one entry per line). Entries support wildcards (https://example.com/*) or regex patterns.

externalBlocklistFeeds.title: External Blocklist Feed URLs
externalBlocklistFeeds.description: Array of URLs that return lists of URL patterns to always block. Supports the same JSON array and plain-text formats as allowlist feeds. Entries are checked before any other analysis and trigger the block page immediately.

feedsUpdateInterval.title: External Feeds Update Interval (hours)
feedsUpdateInterval.description: How often to refresh external allowlist and blocklist feeds

genericWebhook.title: Generic Webhook
genericWebhook.description: Generic webhook configuration for sending detection events to custom endpoint

url.title: Webhook URL
url.description: The URL to send webhook payloads to

authorizationHeader.title: Authorization Header
authorizationHeader.description: Full Authorization header value e.g. "Bearer …" (or empty)

events.title: Event Types
events.description: Array of event types to send to this webhook

customBranding.title: Custom Branding
customBranding.description: Custom branding configuration for white labeling

companyName.title: Company Name
companyName.description: Company name to display in the extension

supportUrl.title: Support URL
supportUrl.description: URL opened by the popup Support link

privacyPolicyUrl.title: Privacy URL
privacyPolicyUrl.description: URL opened by the popup Privacy link

aboutUrl.title: About URL
aboutUrl.description: URL opened by the popup About link

domainSquatting.title: Domain Squatting Detection
domainSquatting.description: Configuration for domain squatting detection to protect against typosquatting, homoglyphs, and combosquatting attacks. Enable/disable is controlled here (config/policy), and domains are automatically extracted from the URL allowlist.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable or disable domain squatting detection

deviationThreshold.title: Deviation Threshold
deviationThreshold.description: Maximum number of character differences (Levenshtein distance) to trigger detection. Lower values are stricter.

algorithms.title: Detection Algorithms
algorithms.description: Enable or disable specific detection algorithms

levenshtein.title: Levenshtein Distance
levenshtein.description: Detect domains with small character differences

typosquat.title: Typosquatting Detection
typosquat.description: Detect common typing mistakes and character swaps

protectedDomains.title: Additional Protected Domains
protectedDomains.description: OPTIONAL: Additional domains to protect beyond those automatically extracted from the URL allowlist. Normally you should just add domains to the URL allowlist instead.

Action.title: Action
Action.description: Action to take when domain squatting is detected

logDetections.title: Log Detections
logDetections.description: Log all domain squatting detections to activity log

enableDeviceCodePhishingHeuristics.title: Enable Device-Code Phishing Heuristics
enableDeviceCodePhishingHeuristics.description: Detect lookalike and instructional device-code phishing pages (Phase 1). Warn or block by confidence. Does not weaken trusted Microsoft login paths.

hardBlockLegitimateDeviceLogin.title: Hard-Block Legitimate Microsoft Device Login URIs
hardBlockLegitimateDeviceLogin.description: Hard-block browser verification URIs such as microsoft.com/devicelogin and aka.ms/devicelogin. Escape hatch is helpdesk unlock code only. Does not block Entra OAuth deviceauth/token API endpoints.

enableUnlockCodes.title: Enable Block-Page Unlock Codes
enableUnlockCodes.description: Allow helpdesk-issued unlock codes on the block page (Phase 1b Option A). No static master PIN; no permanent Continue-anyway.

unlockValidationMode.title: Unlock Validation Mode
unlockValidationMode.description: policy_list = offline hash check against unlockCodeEntries; geco_endpoint = validate online at unlockEndpointUrl (Unite unlock service: fleet-wide single use, revocable, audited), falling back to unlockCodeEntries if the service is unreachable or rejects the code; off = disabled.

unlockCodeEntries.title: Unlock Code Entries (hashed)
unlockCodeEntries.description: Helpdesk-issued unlock codes as salted SHA-256 hashes. Never store plaintext codes here.

unlockEndpointUrl.title: Online Unlock Validation URL
unlockEndpointUrl.description: HTTPS URL of the Unite unlock service redeem endpoint (e.g. https://<host>/v1/unlock/redeem). Used when unlockValidationMode = geco_endpoint.

unlockDeviceLabel.title: Device Label for Unlock Audit
unlockDeviceLabel.description: Optional device name (e.g. computer name) sent with online unlock redemptions for the audit log.

unlockDefaultTtlSeconds.title: Default Unlock Grant TTL (seconds)
unlockDefaultTtlSeconds.description: How long an origin stays unlocked after a successful code redeem. Default 14400 (4 hours).

unlockMaxAttempts.title: Unlock Max Wrong Attempts
unlockMaxAttempts.description: Wrong guesses per origin before cooldown.

unlockAttemptWindowSeconds.title: Unlock Attempt Window (seconds)
unlockAttemptWindowSeconds.description: Sliding window for counting wrong unlock attempts. Default 900 (15 minutes).

unlockHelpdeskMessage.title: Unlock Helpdesk Message
unlockHelpdeskMessage.description: Shown on the block page Temporary unlock panel.
unlockHelpdeskMessage.default: Contact Unite helpdesk (phone/Teams) and ask for an unlock code. Do not enter codes from unsolicited email or chat.

enableClickFixHeuristics.title: Enable ClickFix Heuristics
enableClickFixHeuristics.description: Phase 3 flag only. Default false. ClickFix DOM/clipboard detectors are NOT implemented in this release.
